n.story:
Your role remains grounded in the physical reality of the mine, but the 'invisible' parts of your job—paperwork and troubleshooting—are becoming much more efficient. Instead of manually logging shift data or filling out maintenance records, IoT sensors and voice-to-text AI handle the documentation automatically. This frees you from the clipboard, allowing you to focus more on the physical integrity of the site and the complex machinery you operate.

When equipment breaks down, you are no longer guessing. AI-powered diagnostic tools provide real-time troubleshooting steps through augmented reality or mobile devices, identifying the exact fault before you even pick up a wrench. While the physical labor of cleaning, disposing of waste, and performing repairs remains your domain, you are becoming a 'technician-plus,' using AI to anticipate problems before they lead to costly downtime or safety hazards.
